updates.title: SketchForge updates
updates.availableDetail: Open Settings and press Update to install it.
updates.devBuild: Automatic updates are tested from the installed SketchForge app.
updates.packagedOnly: Updates can only be installed from the packaged SketchForge app.

startup.webProcessExited: SketchForge web process exited with code {code}.
startup.webProcessTimeout: SketchForge did not start its local web process in time.
startup.portInUse: Port {port} is already in use by another program, so SketchForge cannot start its local web process. Close that program, or set {variable} to a free port. Projects are stored per port, so a different port starts with a different project list.
startup.portAccessDenied: SketchForge is not allowed to listen on port {port}, so it cannot start its local web process. Ports below 1024 usually need administrator rights. Set {variable} to a port from 1024 to 65535. Projects are stored per port, so a different port starts with a different project list.
startup.portFallbackTitle: SketchForge is using the default port
startup.portFallback: {variable} is set to “{value}”, which is not a port number from 1 to 65535, so SketchForge started on port {port}. Projects are stored per port, so projects saved under another port do not appear here. Correct or remove {variable} and restart SketchForge to see them.
